topic: Anti-doping basics: stored doping samples can be re-tested later with newer methods (WADA Code Art. 6.6), cases can start up to 10 years later (Art. 17); IOC's 2016 re-tests of Beijing 2008 and London 2012 samples gave 101 new adverse findings; IOC said new tests may come for EPO and small peptides like growth hormone

cards.html:
Tested athletes

A clean test today can turn positive later.

Fact 1

Samples are stored.

After a negative result, your sample can be kept and tested again later, with newer and better tests.

World Anti-Doping Code, Art. 6.6

Real example · 2016

The IOC re-tested stored samples from Beijing 2008 and London 2012.

101

new positive findings that year.

The time limit

10 yrs

A doping case can start up to 10 years after the violation.

Code, Art. 17

Peptides too

Next on the list

The IOC said new tests may come for EPO and small peptides like growth hormone.

Save this for your teammates.
